answer: By the sparrow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. The lagoon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the karst is where a second reviewer recomputes them. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
